description: Construction of Buildings for the Faculty of Management and Finance, University of Ruhuna
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-02-14
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. S.B. Dissanayake, Minister of Higher Education, to award the above contract to the lowest evaluated bidder for a total cost of Rs.231,706,515.46, as recommended by Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.
